objective: Measure and design before approval; independently review before staged implementation; integrate and activate only under existing explicit authority.
clauses: T01 measures scoped current reality and traces actual consumers.
T02 preserves IDs and drafts architecture, Work topology, resource ownership and gaps.
T03 awaits actual architecture approval then performs independent exact-source review.
T04 qualifies prior Work results and pins cross-Work deliveries before integration.
T05 coordinates approved domain/query/consumer/verification/environment Works with one accountable subLead per tab.
T06 retains verification, integration, activation and acceptance as separate milestones; current effects remain held.
